title.it: Formare le parole: prefissi e suffissi

rule.sl:
**Ne:** **un-**, **dis-**: **unhappy**, **disagree**. **in-** se spremeni: pred p, m **im-**: **impossible**, **impolite**; pred l **il-**: **illegal**; pred r **ir-**: **irregular**. Sicer ostane: **incorrect**. **re-** znova: **rebuild**; **mis-** narobe: **misunderstand**; **over-** preveč: **oversleep**.

**Samostalnik:** iz pridevnika **-ness**: **kindness**, **happiness** (y postane i). Iz glagola **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **decision**. Kdo to dela: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **visitor**.

**Pridevnik:** **-ful** z, **-less** brez: **careful**, **careless** (v -ful en l); **-ous**: **dangerous**; **-y**: **rainy**; **-al**: **natural**; **-able**: **comfortable**.

**Glagol:** **-en**: **widen**; **-ise**: **realise**, prav je tudi -ize. **Prislov:** **-ly**: **carefully**, **happily**.

Cela družina: **succeed**, **success**, **successful**, **successfully**, **unsuccessful**. Vrzel: sam za a, the samostalnik, pred samostalnikom pridevnik, z glagolom prislov. Ali ima stavek nikalen pomen?
rule.de:
**Nicht:** **un-**, **dis-**: **unhappy**, **disagree**. **in-** ändert sich: vor p, m **im-**: **impossible**, **impolite**; vor l **il-**: **illegal**; vor r **ir-**: **irregular**. Sonst bleibt es: **incorrect**. **re-** wieder: **rebuild**; **mis-** falsch: **misunderstand**; **over-** zu viel: **oversleep**.

**Nomen:** aus dem Adjektiv **-ness**: **kindness**, **happiness** (aus y wird i). Aus dem Verb **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **decision**. Wer es tut: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **visitor**.

**Adjektiv:** **-ful** mit, **-less** ohne: **careful**, **careless** (in -ful ein l); **-ous**: **dangerous**; **-y**: **rainy**; **-al**: **natural**; **-able**: **comfortable**.

**Verb:** **-en**: **widen**; **-ise**: **realise**, auch -ize ist richtig. **Adverb:** **-ly**: **carefully**, **happily**.

Eine ganze Familie: **succeed**, **success**, **successful**, **successfully**, **unsuccessful**. Die Lücke: allein nach a, the ein Nomen, vor einem Nomen ein Adjektiv, beim Verb ein Adverb. Ist der Satz verneint gemeint?
rule.it:
**Non:** **un-**, **dis-**: **unhappy**, **disagree**. **in-** cambia: prima di p, m **im-**: **impossible**, **impolite**; prima di l il-: **illegal**; prima di r **ir-**: **irregular**. Altrimenti resta: **incorrect**. **re-** di nuovo: **rebuild**; **mis-** male: **misunderstand**; **over-** troppo: **oversleep**.

**Nome:** dall'aggettivo **-ness**: **kindness**, **happiness** (y diventa i). Dal verbo **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **decision**. Chi lo fa: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **visitor**.

**Aggettivo:** **-ful** con, **-less** senza: **careful**, **careless** (in -ful una l); **-ous**: **dangerous**; **-y**: **rainy**; **-al**: **natural**; **-able**: **comfortable**.

**Verbo:** **-en**: **widen**; **-ise**: **realise**, va bene anche -ize. **Avverbio:** **-ly**: **carefully**, **happily**.

Una famiglia intera: **succeed**, **success**, **successful**, **successfully**, **unsuccessful**. Lo spazio: da solo dopo a, the un nome, davanti a un nome un aggettivo, con un verbo un avverbio. La frase è negativa?
rule.en:
**Not:** **un-**, **dis-**: **unhappy**, **disagree**. **in-** changes: before p, m **im-**: **impossible**, **impolite**; before l **il-**: **illegal**; before r **ir-**: **irregular**. Otherwise it stays: **incorrect**. **re-** again: **rebuild**; **mis-** wrongly: **misunderstand**; **over-** too much: **oversleep**.

**A noun:** from an adjective **-ness**: **kindness**, **happiness** (y becomes i). From a verb **-ment**: **agreement**; **-tion**, **-sion**: **information**, **decision**. Who does it: **-er**, **-or**: **farmer**, **visitor**.

**An adjective:** **-ful** with, **-less** without: **careful**, **careless** (one l in -ful); **-ous**: **dangerous**; **-y**: **rainy**; **-al**: **natural**; **-able**: **comfortable**.

**A verb:** **-en**: **widen**; **-ise**: **realise**, -ize is right too. **An adverb:** **-ly**: **carefully**, **happily**.

A whole family: **succeed**, **success**, **successful**, **successfully**, **unsuccessful**. The gap: alone after a, the a noun, before a noun an adjective, with a verb an adverb. Does the sentence mean not?

examples.it: Il piano di Sam è stato un successo.

tip.sl: 💡 **careful** ima en l, *careful* ni *carefull*. Slovenski *ne-* je v angleščini **un-**, **dis-**, **im-** … naučiš se ga z besedo.
tip.de: 💡 Deutsch *un-* ist nicht immer **un-**: **impossible**, **dishonest**, **irregular**. Und **careful** mit einem l.
tip.it: 💡 L'italiano ha *im-*, *il-*, *ir-* come l'inglese: *impossibile*, *illegale*: **impossible**, **illegal**. Ma *infelice* è **unhappy**.
tip.en: 💡 One l in **-ful**: **careful**. y becomes i: **happiness**, **beautiful**.
